title: Sample-audit accepted corpus gold before scheduling adjudication

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text:
# Gold sample-audit report (KDATAP-f45596)

**Auditor:** cursor cloud agent (`cursor/gold-sample-audit-6959`)  
**Date:** 2026-08-31  
**Corpus:** 29 packets, `tests/benchmark/repos/*/annotations/`, `review_state: accepted`  
**Method:** stratified deterministic sample; evidence verified against pinned clones in `tests/benchmark/.cache/repos/<key>@<commit>/`

---

## 1. Sample method

**Population (accepted rows, per epic KDATAP-b0d5e2 — not re-counted for migration scale):**

| Layer | Epic scale | Live accepted (this checkout) |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| mentions (`pii_signals`) | 357 | 357 |
| data items | 308 adjudication queue | 361 accepted |
| components | 563 (481 taxonomy + 52 vendor + 30 `actor:user`) | 563 |
| data flows | 436 regold queue | 436 |
| **Total accepted** | ~1,792 cited | **1,717** |

**Stratification:** 116 non-empty packet×layer strata (29 packets × 4 layers). Within each stratum, annotations sorted by SHA-256 of `id`; systematic spread sampling at ~10% (`min 1`, `max 5` per stratum; all rows when stratum ≤3).

**Sample size:** **212 rows** — mentions 43, data items 45, components 62, data flows 62 (61 positive + 1 negative). All 29 packets represented (4–18 rows each).

**Evidence check:** cloned all 29 pinned repos (sparse checkout per manifest) and read each sample row's `evidence.file_path` at `start_line`–`end_line`. Automated heuristics flagged candidates; every flagged row and all non-debt rows received manual read.

**Out of scope (per task):** detector retuning, gold rewrites, full 1,717-row recount, baseline publish.

---

## 2. Error taxonomy and counts

Errors split into **quality errors** (wrong gold) vs **migration debt** (accepted under legacy contract; epic already tracks remediation).

### 2a. Quality errors (sample)

| Category | Count in sample | Rate | Examples |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| **Mislabel** | 2 | 0.9% | see below |
| **Duplicate / collapsed entity** | 1 | 0.5% | see below |
| **Type / subtype error** | 0 | 0% | subtype labels (`payment_processor`, `auth_provider`) match taxonomy intent |
| **Total quality-error rows** | **3** | **1.4%** | |

**Mislabel examples (verified against source):**

1. `discourse` / `discourse-auth-token-client-ip` [data_items] — `client_ip` (`:inet` column comment in `user_auth_token.rb:304`) labeled `user_identifier`; concept should be `ip_address`.
2. `magento` / `magento-address-prefix` [data_items] — `prefix` getter in `AddressInterface.php:255` is salutation (Mr/Mrs), not `person_name`.

**Duplicate example:**

3. `directus` / `directus-admin-actor` [components] — `actor:user` at `api/src/types/auth.ts:7` duplicates `directus-user-type` (same key + evidence span; collapsed entities).

Mentions layer: **0 quality errors in 43 sample rows** (including negative cases). Spot-checks on passed rows (e.g. `wordpress-display-name-pii-signal`, `vgs-django-ssn-pii-signal`) confirmed evidence supports concept.

### 2b. Migration debt (expected; epic-owned)

| Category | Sample rows | Corpus (accepted positives) | Epic reference |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| **Source-token data-item identity** | 25 / 45 positives (56%) | 282 / 302 positives (93%) | KDATAP-a0e80b — 308 adjudication |
| **Flow endpoints not graph nodes** | 59 / 61 positives (97%) | 419 / 419 (100%) | KDATAP-8e7756 — 436 regold |
| **Code-level component instance names** | 36 / 62 (58%) | 463 / 519 (89%) | KDATAP-00e64a instance rule |

Flow keys use descriptive slugs (`flow:plaintext-password->password_hash`) rather than typed component keys (`flow:asset:api->asset:database`). This is systemic, not sporadic mislabeling.

**Duplicate component groups (full corpus, not just sample):** 14 groups across 7 packets — `discourse` (6), `magento` (3), `directus`, `ghost`, `medusa`, `nopcommerce`, `strapi` (1 each).

---

## 3. Per-packet trust notes

Debt % = share of accepted **positive** rows carrying source-token data-item, untyped-flow, or code-level instance debt.

| Packet | Sample rows | Quality errors in sample | Debt burden | Trust note |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- |
| auth0-express | 4 | 0 | 60% | Small; flows untyped; mentions OK |
| directus | 4 | 1 duplicate | 72% | **Do not migrate components** until duplicate resolved |
| discourse | 18 | 1 mislabel | 83% | **High debt**; 6 duplicate component groups |
| drupal | 7 | 0 | 75% | Flow/data-item debt only |
| easy-school | 7 | 0 | 57% | Starter packet; moderate debt |
| exposed | 4 | 0 | 75% | Tiny; flow debt |
| flask-login | 8 | 0 | 54% | Moderate debt |
| ghost | 8 | 0 | 60% | 1 duplicate component group |
| gitea | 6 | 0 | 54% | Moderate debt |
| hyperswitch-vault | 6 | 0 | 54% | Starter packet; moderate debt |
| keycloak | 7 | 0 | 61% | Compact; instance names on JPA tables |
| magento | 15 | 1 mislabel | 87% | **Highest debt**; 3 duplicate groups |
| medusa | 6 | 0 | 75% | 1 duplicate group |
| medusa-customer | 6 | 0 | 57% | Moderate debt |
| nopcommerce | 6 | 0 | 69% | 1 duplicate group |
| orchard-core | 8 | 0 | 74% | High flow debt |
| ory-kratos-password | 4 | 0 | 75% | Tiny packet |
| pocketbase | 8 | 0 | 66% | Moderate-high debt |
| posthog-user | 6 | 0 | 58% | Moderate debt |
| redmine | 8 | 0 | 69% | Moderate-high debt |
| saleor | 7 | 0 | 53% | Moderate debt |
| spree | 8 | 0 | 75% | High flow debt |
| spring-petclinic | 6 | 0 | 58% | Moderate debt |
| strapi | 5 | 0 | 72% | 1 duplicate group |
| supabase-js | 4 | 0 | 52% | Moderate debt |
| vapor | 4 | 0 | 67% | Moderate debt |
| vgs-django | 8 | 0 | 62% | Starter packet; mentions clean in sample |
| wordpress | 16 | 0 | 86% | **High debt**; large component cardinality |
| yjdh-employee | 8 | 0 | 53% | Moderate debt |

**No packet is migration-clean end-to-end** (all carry flow debt). Packets with **additional** trust risk beyond systemic debt: `discourse`, `magento`, `directus`, `wordpress` (scale + duplicates/mislabels).

---

## 4. Recommendation

### Verdict: **NO-GO** for full-corpus migration; **SHRINK** scope

**Do not** schedule the ~750-adjudication workstreams against the full 1,717 accepted rows as-is. The sample quality-error rate is low (**1.4%**, 3/212) — mentions evidence is trustworthy — but **56% of the sample (120/212) and ~90% of data-item/component positives carry known migration debt** already enumerated on KDATAP-b0d5e2.

### Layer guidance

| Layer | Go / no-go | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Mentions** (`pii_signals`) | **Conditional GO** | 0/43 sample quality errors; proceed with KDATAP-fafa9f canonical-key migration on evidence-validated rows |
| **Components** | **Conditional GO** | 0 mislabels in sample; apply KDATAP-00e64a instance rule; **exclude** 7 packets with duplicate-collapse groups until regrouped |
| **Data items** | **NO-GO** | 93% source-token identities; 2 mislabels found; keep KDATAP-a0e80b blocked |
| **Data flows** | **NO-GO** | 100% lack typed graph endpoints; keep KDATAP-8e7756 blocked |

### Suggested shrink (human scope decision)

1. **Phase 1 (earn trust):** mentions migration on all 29 packets + component taxonomy pass on **22 packets** without duplicate-collapse groups.
2. **Hold out:** `discourse`, `magento`, `directus`, `ghost`, `medusa`, `nopcommerce`, `strapi` for component work until duplicate groups adjudicated.
3. **Do not migrate:** any data-item or flow rows until dedicated adjudication/regold epics complete.
4. **Fix before migration:** 3 sample-verified quality errors (2 mislabels, 1 duplicate) — prefer Kanbus notes / adjudication tickets, not silent YAML edits in this audit.

### Adjudication scheduling

- **KDATAP-a0e80b** (data items): remain **blocked**
- **KDATAP-8e7756** (flows): remain **blocked**
- Unblock only after human accepts this recommendation and scope shrink.

---

*Audit complete. Issue stays `in_progress` pending human acceptance.*

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text:
## Manager review — do not treat this as a rotten-gold shrink

Accept the sample method (212 stratified rows, all 29 packets, evidence read at span). Mentions 0/43 quality errors is the important new fact.

**Do not shrink the corpus because of a 1.4% quality-error rate.** That is not the high-error trigger on this ticket. The two mislabels and one duplicate are ordinary adjudication notes, not a reason to drop packets.

The NO-GO on data items and flows restates debt already on KDATAP-b0d5e2 (source-token identities, untyped endpoints). That is sequencing, not a new trust failure. Keep KDATAP-a0e80b and KDATAP-8e7756 blocked until a human accepts scope.

The only *new* scope claim is holding out 7 packets from component work because of duplicate-collapse groups. That depends on the KDATAP-471fdc cardinality ruling — do not exclude them until that is answered.

Issue stays in progress. A human must accept or reject the phase-1 recommendation.
